skill_yaml:
skill: door_push
dsl_version: 2
phases:
- id: approach_1
  type: approach
  generator: bezier_curve
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: site
    entity: door_handle
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.1
    - 0.0
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
- id: contact_1
  type: contact
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: force_threshold_switch
  termination: force_exceeded
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.12
      axis: world_y
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: negative
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    contact_force:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 1.0
      - 20.0
      default: 5.0
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.force_threshold
        mode: replace
    contact_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.005
      - 0.05
      default: 0.02
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
- id: push_1
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: contact_detected
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.2
      axis: world_y
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: negative
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
- id: retract_1
  type: retract
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.15
    - 0.0
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    retract_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
